name: Azelaic acid
description: Naturally occurring saturated dicarboxylic acid, found in whole grains and made in small amounts by the body

note.text: No published trial of a cream combining azelaic acid and niacinamide turned up in a PubMed search (Oct 2026).

bullets: **Exact mechanism** is not known, per the Azelex label
**In lab tests,** active against two skin bacteria; clinical meaning unknown
**Skin biopsies** showed a thinner outer layer and less filaggrin
**In rosacea,** the way it works is unknown, per the Finacea label

practical.halfLife: About 12 hours after skin use; 45 minutes by mouth
practical.pharmacokinetics: About 4% absorbed; mainly excreted unchanged in urine
practical.soldAs: Prescription cream, gel and foam (Azelex, Finacea, generics)
practical.monitored: Skin reactions; skin lightening in dark skin

regulatory.text: Compounded combinations are not FDA approved

references: FDA, Finacea gel 15% prescribing information (DailyMed), Apr 2011
